Statistics of the '''[[Scottish Football League]]''' in season '''1892–93'''.

==Overview==
[[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] became [[Scottish Football League]] champions for the first time.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.statto.com/football/stats/scotland/football-league/1892-1893/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110823061839/http://www.statto.com/football/stats/scotland/football-league/1892-1893/ |archive-date=23 August 2011 |title=Scottish Football League 1892−1893 Table |publisher=statto.com |access-date=23 April 2012}}</ref>
